_comment: Hand-curated finds and corrections that arrive between source refreshes (team messages, new listings). build.ts merges these after parsing the workbook: 'set' overwrites fields, 'note' appends to notes. New rows go in 'new' with at least name, address, region, type.

set.name_detail: The Oakland Campus (BH Properties leasing site)

pl-holy-names-university-dorms.note: Elliot flagged the leasing site Aug 26 (a massive campus in the East Bay). Same campus we track: BH Properties is actively marketing ~387,000 sf across 10 buildings; the 181,200 sf Upper Campus Complex holds Student Residences 1-3 plus cafeteria, chapel event center and student lounge. One building (Raskob School) already reserved, so interim deals are moving. Still East Bay: scores 0 on transit by rule, but it is the strongest expansion-scale dorm stock on the list.
